checks.describe: the platformops v0.1 checkpoint has inventory.py and its test file
pyproject.toml carries the v0.1.0 release version
ruff check passes inside the checkpoint
checks.run: cd labs/platformops && uv run ruff check . 2>&1

checks.describe: ruff format has nothing left to rewrite in the checkpoint
checks.run: cd labs/platformops && uv run ruff format --check . 2>&1

checks.describe: pytest passes inside the checkpoint, including the new inventory tests
the report prints the missing-owner-tag section
checks.run: cd labs/platformops && uv run python -m platformops.inventory | grep -c 'Missing owner tag:'

checks.describe: the report prints the low-memory-in-prod section
checks.run: cd labs/platformops && uv run python -m platformops.inventory | grep -c 'Prod servers with low memory'

checks.describe: the Phase B extension's summary section is present in the report
checks.run: cd labs/platformops && uv run python -m platformops.inventory | grep -c '^Summary:$'

checks.describe: the Phase B extension's sorted-by-name section is present in the report
checks.run: cd labs/platformops && uv run python -m platformops.inventory | grep -c 'sorted by name'

checks.describe: find_missing_owner flags exactly the two servers with no owner tag
checks.run: uv run --directory labs/platformops python -c "from platformops.inventory import find_missing_owner, INVENTORY; assert sorted(find_missing_owner(INVENTORY)) == ['web-02', 'worker-01']; print('OK')"

checks.describe: find_low_memory_prod flags exactly the two under-provisioned prod servers
checks.run: uv run --directory labs/platformops python -c "from platformops.inventory import find_low_memory_prod, INVENTORY; assert sorted(find_low_memory_prod(INVENTORY)) == ['api-02', 'web-02']; print('OK')"

checks.describe: count_by_environment matches the real 6/2/2 split of the inventory
checks.run: uv run --directory labs/platformops python -c "from platformops.inventory import count_by_environment, INVENTORY; assert count_by_environment(INVENTORY) == {'prod': 6, 'staging': 2, 'dev': 2}; print('OK')"

checks.describe: the reference Phase B extension (filter/sort/summary) behaves correctly and sort_by_name does not mutate the original list
checks.run: uv run --directory labs/platformops python -c "from platformops.inventory import build_summary, sort_by_name, filter_by_environment, INVENTORY; s = build_summary(INVENTORY); assert s['total_servers'] == 10 and s['total_cpu'] == 56 and s['total_memory_gb'] == 158; before = [x['name'] for x in INVENTORY]; sorted_servers = sort_by_name(INVENTORY); assert [x['name'] for x in sorted_servers] == sorted(before); assert [x['name'] for x in INVENTORY] == before; assert len(filter_by_environment(INVENTORY, 'prod')) == 6; print('OK')"
